description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page handling the logic for a theory exam interface. It manages loading questions from a database, displaying them, handling user responses, timing the exam, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the server-side code for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page, including event handlers, data loading, and submission logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, populates questions from the database based on session data, manages exam timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Submits the student's answers to the database and updates relevant tables, then redirects to the dashboard.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the exam timer countdown and timeout display.
